question: How did each salesperson's annual total sales compare to their annual sales quota? Provide the difference between their total sales and the quota for each year, organized by salesperson and year.
sql:
SELECT 
    businessentityid,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(modifieddate AS DATE)) AS VARCHAR) as year,
    CAST(salesytd AS FLOAT) as total_sales,
    CASE WHEN salesquota = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(salesquota AS FLOAT) END as sales_quota,
    CASE WHEN salesquota = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(salesytd AS FLOAT) - CAST(salesquota AS FLOAT) END as difference
FROM salesperson
ORDER BY businessentityid, year
